CHAPTER 04 · A NOTE FROM YOUR GIRL

To my Jaanduuu,

Who knew that the person I met because of a little attraction would become someone I miss this much? In these two months, you've become my favourite notification, my favourite distraction, and the person I want to tell all my random thoughts to.

I still think about how you looked after me when I was sick — making sure I ate, bathed, and took my medicines. You had your own things going on, but you still showed up for me. That's when I started seeing the person behind all that charm. And yes, your clingy side helped too. Don't let it go to your head. 😏

I know things with your family have been difficult lately. I see how hard you work, and I hope you never feel you have to carry every difficult day alone. I want to be there in your struggling days, even if distance means I can't always hold your hand. I may not know exactly what the future looks like, but I want to keep choosing us, one day at a time.

Today, your only job is to feel loved, eat something nice, smile a little extra, and accept that your girlfriend is ridiculously fond of you. Happy birthday, my Jaanduuu. I wish I could steal a hug from you right now.

I'm always rooting for you. Your biggest fan, your teammate, and your favourite troublemaker. ❤️
